description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, as measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric across training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Training Steps (×10³),” spans from 0 to 50,000 steps with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000 (i.e., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BPC,” ranges from 1.1 to 2.2 with major ticks every 0.2 units, also on a linear scale. The black line with downward-pointing triangle markers, labeled “SMoE Validating,” begins at approximately BPC = 2.15 at 0 steps, drops sharply to around 1.4 by 5,000 steps, and then gradually declines to stabilize near 1.15 by 50,000 steps. The magenta line with star markers, labeled “SimSMoE Validating,” starts at approximately BPC = 2.18, follows a similar sharp initial drop to about 1.4 by 5,000 steps, and then continues to decrease more smoothly, reaching approximately 1.13 by 50,000 steps. Both lines show a rapid initial improvement followed by slower convergence, with the SimSMoE model consistently achieving slightly lower (better) BPC values than SMoE after the first 5,000 steps.
